hub.title: Games
hub.subtitle: Quick games for your phone. They work offline and each one installs as its own app.
hub.more: Solitaire and Tetris 3D are at rachao.app/games
enche_ai.name: Fill It Up!
enche_ai.tagline: Sort the flavors. One per glass.
enche_ai.desc: Pour layer by layer until every glass holds a single flavor. Coffee, juice, açaí and milkshakes at the diner counter.
enche_ai.how_to: Tap a glass, then where to pour. You can only pour onto the same flavor or into an empty glass.
enche_ai.toast_stuck_extra: No moves left. Undo or ask for the extra glass.
enche_ai.toast_stuck: No moves left. Undo or restart.
enche_ai.toast_no_way_extra: There's no way out from here. Undo or ask for the extra glass.
enche_ai.toast_no_way: There's no way out from here. Undo or restart.
enche_ai.toast_hint: Pour from the first glowing glass into the second.
enche_ai.toast_extra: One more glass on the counter.
enche_ai.win_sub_3: No help at all. Chef's kiss.
enche_ai.win_sub_2: Almost perfect. Try without help for the third star.
enche_ai.win_sub_1: Delivered! You can do it with less help.
enche_ai.opt_vibrate: Vibrate when a glass is done
